VIP Space Odyssey

Condominium in Rawai
HomeSaleVIP Space Odyssey

Construction progress photos published by the developer (cropped from its monthly update graphics, branding frame removed). No renders are available from the developer page.

Project overview

VIP Space Odyssey is a mixed-use development by VIP Property Development Thailand in southern Phuket, between Rawai and Nai Harn and against forested hills. The portal lists 619 units in 5 buildings of up to 8 floors on about 25,600 sqm; other sources describe a smaller first phase with a number of pool villas, so the final scale is not confirmed. Completion is scheduled for December 2028. The developer's page shows monthly construction-progress photos, with piling and foundation works under way between March and August 2026.

Listed unit types include studios of about 29 sqm, one-bedroom units of about 32 sqm and two-bedroom units of about 60 sqm, with a larger two-bedroom type of about 120 sqm. Shared facilities listed are a communal pool, garden, kids' club, gym, parking and 24-hour security. Listed fees are THB 60 per sqm per month for common areas, a sinking fund of THB 400 per sqm and a freehold premium of THB 10,000 per sqm.

Rawai Beach is about 0.6 km away in a straight line, Rawai Park 1.3 km, Yanui Beach 2.0 km and Promthep Cape 2.8 km. Prices are advertised by portals from about THB 4.4 million and change; confirm availability and terms before reserving.
